body:
[Erowid Note: 
While the author reported the substance used as 5-MeO-DMT, they seem to conflate NN-DMT and 5-MeO-DMT. These substances have different effects and dosages. Most often the error made is that the term "DMT" is used as shorthand to refer to 5-Methoxy-DMT. However, because of the ambiguity in the substance name, it is uncertain whether the author is speaking about 5-MeO-DMT throughout this report or not. See
5-MeO-DMT is Not "DMT"
.]
I write this as the effects have worn off but are still fresh in my memory.
I come from a fairly good upbringing, no broken home, less problems if anything than your average family. I'm usually very level headed and constantly get remarked on how 'laid back' I am about everything.
I won't bullshit you guys with
hippy la-de-da language
. I meditate but when I say meditate I mean lie in my boxer shorts and scratch myself while playing halo. I won't say that I want to get closer to any kind of spiritual realm or anything like that.
I did it to get out my face and mess about with my own brain chemistry.
Last night I took a retarded amount of DMT bombed in cigarette papers I foolishly knew that I wanted roughly 10-20mg but I was eyeballing the weight (bad idea, get some scales)... At first it came on quite nice, with a happy feeling not unlike acid, but then so much more intense than any other hallucinogen I have ever tried.
It all went pear shaped after I threw up though, I knew the owner of the place I was crashing at was really mad at me, this lead me to beleive that I had to get out or I would most certainly die. I have never been a religious person, in fact I normally feel that the unshaking belief in something that cannot be proven empirically to be a lower state of being. However, DMT made me lose that sense of scepticism and I had no doubt in my mind that I was going to die. My friend (who I really will need to go back to and beg for forgiveness leaving his place in such a state) walked me home safely but I fell at the door, couldn't get the key in and woke my parents... Not what this trip needed, I already knew I was going to die, now I'd have my dad with his draconian views on the subject lecturing me while I'm trying to ward off the devil himself.
Beleive me when I say I thought I was invincible, I have a strange tolerance for all drugs it seems, and after an initial few fruitless hits smoked, I assumed this drug was no different from all those other drugs mere mortals consumed in trivial doses. Thankfully DMT was on hand and give me the kick in the nutsack that I needed.
All in all it was the worst experience of my life, its not often that one gets to see his own death as it happens and have all the regrets he's had about his own life come to the fore... And heres where the twist in the story comes, I wouldn't change this for the world. I honestly feel I am a better person now I've seen my own death, how many people get two shots at life?
Never doing anything hallucinogenic again, it came to me as a revelation when I woke up (you do not know relief like the relief that comes after waking up on what you knew at that time to be your deathbed). THIS was what I was after... All those nights taking upward of 60-70 mg of 2CB (another story for another time!) or miscounting how much acid I've taken like it was beers I was throwing down my neck. All those nights of just seeing how far I could push the boundaries and still come out the other end feeling groovy were leading up to this night. The grand finale.
As soon as college starts up again I'm going to ask that girl I've been staring at across the lunch hall for the last few weeks what her name is and I'm going to be the best damned artist I can be, all thanks to DMT making me realise what I'd regret if I died.
